scope: 200 name candidates and 300 numbered editions reviewed. Broader search is not complete.

editions.decision: All visually confirmed as editions of the RARE.PEPE remaster. Retain their existing Edition traits and collection membership; do not flatten them into 300 independent direct RAREPEPE derivative links.

media_followup.reason: Multiple candidates show a collection-wide contact sheet rather than individual card art; do not infer a card-specific link from that image.

faux_bitcorn.decision: One explicit RAREPEPE derivative identified (RARECOB). Shared Bitcorn frame or theme alone is not a specific original-work relationship. FAUXCORNCASH vs BCASHCORN checked; no sufficiently specific visual match established.
